title: Seeds run
description: State (seeds-last.json): the last `prober seeds` run on the branch, one outcome per seed it ran (a probe without one has a single outcome, `no seed`), the probes it skipped and why, and per probe the run that last caught every one of its seeds, which decides what the next run without --all skips (design/adr/0107). Never evidence: a seeded run proves the probe, not the product.

schemaVersion.description: The schema version. A file or line without it is version 1 (the Python baseline).

all.description: Whether the run was `--all`, every probe whatever its record says, as a release runs it. Absent in a file written before footprint selection.

probes.description: Per probe, the run that last caught every seed it owes; a probe with a seed missed, or that never ran, has no entry, so it runs next time. Carried forward for the probes a run skipped.

identity.description: The seeds identity it was caught under: the probe's identity, its seeds and the content of their patches.

commit.description: HEAD of the run that caught them; the product footprint and the patched files are compared with it.

skipped.description: The probes this run skipped, unchanged since every seed of theirs was caught, each with the reason printed.

obligation.description: The claim's obligation the seed breaks (decision 104), or null for a seed that names none.

seed.description: The patch and the environment toggle applied, or (none).

violations.description: Rows the seed made violations that the unseeded probe does not have.

rows.description: Rows that ran under the seed.

seeds.description: One outcome per seed this run ran; the probes it skipped have none.
